metadata.name: German + English Usenet (Dual Audio)
metadata.description:
Usenet-only filtering and sorting profile driven by the Stream Expression Language (SEL).

- Keeps only Usenet releases with **German and/or English** audio.
- Prioritises **dual-audio** (German + English) over single-audio, and **HDR** over SDR.
- Limits resolution to **2160p / 1080p / 720p** — 720p is only shown when fewer than 5 x 1080p results exist.
- Subtitles are not required or filtered.

Priority order (highest first):
1. Dual Audio + HDR
2. Dual Audio + SDR
3. Single Audio + HDR
4. Single Audio + SDR

See the [README](https://github.com/JCSynthTux/AIOStreams-SEL-Templates) for full documentation.
metadata.author: JCSynthTux

excludedStreamExpressions.expression: /* Audio: German or English */ negate(merge(language(streams, 'German'), language(streams, 'English')), streams)
/* 720p only when fewer than 5 x 1080p */ count(resolution(streams, '1080p')) >= 5 ? resolution(streams, '720p') : []

preferredStreamExpressions.expression: /* Single Audio + SDR */ negate(visualTag(negate(language(language(streams, 'German'), 'English'), streams), 'HDR', 'DV', 'HDR10', 'HDR10+', 'HLG'), negate(language(language(streams, 'German'), 'English'), streams))

metadata.name: Japanese + Korean + Chinese/Mandarin Usenet
metadata.description:
Usenet-only filtering and sorting profile driven by the Stream Expression Language (SEL).

- Keeps only Usenet releases with **Japanese, Korean, Chinese or Mandarin** audio (both `Chinese` and `Mandarin` tags are matched to cover indexer naming differences).
- Requires **English or German** subtitles.
- Prefers **HDR** over SDR.
- Limits resolution to **2160p / 1080p / 720p** — 720p is only shown when fewer than 5 x 1080p results exist.

Priority order (highest first):
1. CJK + HDR
2. CJK + SDR

See the [README](https://github.com/JCSynthTux/AIOStreams-SEL-Templates) for full documentation.
metadata.author: JCSynthTux

excludedStreamExpressions.expression: /* Audio: Japanese, Korean, Chinese or Mandarin */ negate(merge(language(streams, 'Japanese'), language(streams, 'Korean'), language(streams, 'Chinese'), language(streams, 'Mandarin')), streams)
/* Subtitles: English or German required */ negate(merge(subtitle(streams, 'English'), subtitle(streams, 'German')), streams)
/* 720p only when fewer than 5 x 1080p */ count(resolution(streams, '1080p')) >= 5 ? resolution(streams, '720p') : []

preferredStreamExpressions.expression: /* CJK + HDR */ visualTag(merge(language(streams, 'Japanese'), language(streams, 'Korean'), language(streams, 'Chinese'), language(streams, 'Mandarin')), 'HDR', 'DV', 'HDR10', 'HDR10+', 'HLG')

/* CJK + SDR */ negate(visualTag(merge(language(streams, 'Japanese'), language(streams, 'Korean'), language(streams, 'Chinese'), language(streams, 'Mandarin')), 'HDR', 'DV', 'HDR10', 'HDR10+', 'HLG'), merge(language(streams, 'Japanese'), language(streams, 'Korean'), language(streams, 'Chinese'), language(streams, 'Mandarin')))
